name: CaughtTheMagic
summary: Uploads a photo of your living room and returns a Santa cam still or video, with a free preview before you buy credits.
description: CaughtTheMagic turns a photo of your home into a doorbell, night-vision or security-cam style image of Santa by the tree, and can turn that into a video. You can try a free preview of your own room with no account. There is no subscription: 1 photo uses 1 credit and 1 video uses 4. Failed renders return credits; unused credits can be refunded on request.

pricing.details: Free preview; packs 4 € / 9 € / 18 € (promo 3 € / 6 € / 12 € until 1 Dec 2026). No subscription.
pricing.label: Freemium

features: Free room preview, no account needed
Santa doorbell, night-vision and security-cam styles
automatic credit refunds on failed renders
